message:
Combine coprime fusion with the auxiliary-index gap: six ten-positive equations

candidates/ten-positive-gap-fusion holds six complete ten-strictly-positive
Con(ZFC) equations, each a literal row edit of wave-12 package 116's
96-row coprime-fusion schedule (pinned by SHA-256), with a full ordinary
proof (PROOF.md) relative to the inherited source61/native/controller
calibration and the whole original compact44 tuple:

  scaled X = w q:   89 / 288,  91 / 283 (centre (A-1)DE),  92 / 278 (ADE)
  direct X = q + x: 94 / 262,  96 / 258 (centre (A-1)DE),  97 / 254 (ADE)
  (operations / exact degree)

Devices: coprime fusion of the first and strong roots (packages 116 and
113, independently), the transport weight W = 1 + g*b (package 117 with a
centre; package 118's auxiliary-index gap without one), the scaled
zero-offset coordinate, and optional centres after 113.

PROOF.md proves the fifth-index gap in the fused kernel (V > 8Q^2,
b > 8Q > 2HDE), one transport-sign lemma uniform in the centre,
completeness for all three centres, and the exact degrees from the
expansion N = 4 delta^2 M^4 V^2 (Gamma^2 - a) + lower terms.

Attribution, from the independent review (INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md: sound,
no FATAL or GAP): the research session found the same 89/288 polynomial
and the fused-kernel gap argument concurrently (90d8b714f9, 16:29), and the
scaled sharp 92/278 polynomial is package 117's and the research reused-b
one (fc77fcd31a). Net new: 94/262 and 97/254 (one row below the research
evaluators of the same polynomials, via 116's leaner direct carrier), and
the lower-centre polynomials 91/283 and 96/258 (the latter one row below
the research 97/258).

verify.py (64 checks, all pass): binding and port box; counts and
liveness; exact degrees on random lines modulo 2^127-1 and 2^89-1; the
section-6 leading forms against the top coefficient on rays; the
expansion identity; an independent evaluation of the section-1 formulas
against each circuit (catches the reviewer's three planted mutations);
Pell traces. build.py --check rebuilds all six from 116's file.
